agent_explanation: Momentum is conserved to machine precision through step 5 (matches step 0), then drifts at step 9 when heavy bodies 0 and 1 close-approach to distance ~1.45 with speeds ~9.2 and ~2.9 and substeps jump to 11. Adaptive substep/leapfrog force evaluation becomes asymmetric or insufficiently accurate under strong acceleration/fast motion, injecting net momentum (and angular momentum). Reducing dt alone removes the failure.
